questions.prompt: Which command lists all clouds known to the local Juju client?
questions.explanation: The 'juju clouds' command lists all clouds available and configured on the client.

questions.prompt: What does bootstrapping a Juju controller accomplish?
options: It provisions the controller instance and state database on the chosen cloud substrate
It installs Python on the client machine
It deletes all models in the environment
It builds a charm package from source
questions.answer: It provisions the controller instance and state database on the chosen cloud substrate
questions.explanation: Bootstrapping creates the controller VM/container, sets up the database, and connects the client to the cloud.

questions.prompt: Which command lists all controllers known to your local client?
questions.explanation: 'juju controllers' lists all registered controllers, their active model, cloud region, and connection status.
